hobbyData.description: I am an avid reader of fantasy fiction and any book which has an amazing story to tell. In my opinion stories hold a lot of power. Layered characters in a wonderful imagination and the decisions they make in a particular situation can tell us a lot about the way of life. My personal opinion: Every book is a self help book because reading is therapy.

Apart from listening to music, I also love to create my own with the beautiful 88-key beast. I compose when I am lucky and I play when I am not busy. I try to incorporate what Beethoven said about music: "To play a wrong note is insignificant, but to play without passion is inexcusable."

interests.title: Piano
interests.description: I play piano and compose when inspiration strikes. Making music is one of my favorite ways to spend time away from code.

interests.title: Reading
interests.description: Mostly fantasy fiction. I enjoy imaginative worlds, layered characters, and a story that stays with me after the last page.
